A.span: जिनके लिए स्कन्ध, धातु और आयतन विद्यमान नहीं हैं
A.explanation: Tibetan/Sanskrit locative places absence of aggregates in the vehicle/dharma, not "for" the bodhisattvas; referent shifted.

B.explanation: Misspelling of animitta; should be अनिमित्त.

B.span: आकाश की व्यापकता में स्थित होने के इस अर्थ का विचार करो
B.explanation: Commentaries read: on what does space itself rest? It rests on nothing. "Abiding in vastness" misses this point.

B.span: उन्हें अवैवर्तिक रूप में व्याकृत जानना चाहिए
B.explanation: Tibetan says this sign is an irreversible prophecy; B turns it into persons known as prophesied.

A.span: कुसीद बोधिसत्त्व तो स्वयं ही पतित है
A.explanation: Commentaries: another bodhisattva who gauges/measures this practitioner is ruined; "lazy bodhisattva" is a wrong sense and referent.
"Water-carrying" (chu chun, kumbhadāsī) maidservant is reduced to just "a maidservant".

B.explanation: Tibetan and Mipham: unskilled in means (thabs la mi mkhas); "ignorant" overstates and loses the sense of skill in means.
Tibetan has a single guide (rnam par 'dren pa); plural is wrong.

A.span: वह प्रचुर और अप्रमेय हो जाता है
A.explanation: Subject unclear: it is the result/giving that becomes much and immeasurable, not the giver.

A.span: दान में कुशल वह सर्वस्व दान करता है
A.explanation: Gtong ba (relinquishing) rendered with the same word दान as sbyin pa; distinction lost.

B.span: वह बहुत और अप्रमेय हो जाता है
B.explanation: Subject unclear: the result becomes much and immeasurable, not the giver.
Same term rgyud rendered वंश for Buddha but परम्परा for Dharma and Sangha; inconsistent within segment.
